referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes: concrete and energy requirements; transports of radioactive waste and concrete; infrastructure requirement; methan emissions to air; and, seepage water treatement. This describes the operation of a repository for intermediate and long-lived low radioactive waste in the Swiss context.
